card.name: Inside rare drug names
card.fires_on: The opening piece of a drug name split into parts, such as vec in vecuronium or ri in riociguat, in drug-interaction text. It also fires on a few odd breaks such as the q of a suffix or the s after trimethoprim.

modes.label: Start of split drug name
modes.description: The first piece of a less common drug name, often after 'such as' or 'and'.

modes.description: The vec piece of vecuronium in a list of blocking agents.

modes.label: Other broken-up names
modes.description: Odd splits in a drug name or abbreviation.

card.plain: It marks the first chunk of a long, uncommon drug name such as vecuronium or riociguat.
